summary: A shared 80-deep cross-section on every plot: a cream-white calcite arcade bar (z 3..14, 8-block bays of round arches with a window above each, cornice and balustrade at y 29), a 49-wide nave under a low deepslate roof with a glazed monitor ridge at y 38, and a grey andesite bay bar. Plot 0 adds a smooth-quartz pavilion with three tall arches, 2 blocks proud, and a 15-wide tower rising to y 70 with four 11-wide clock dials, then two arched belfry stages that step in, a lantern, a dome and a flagpole at y 103. Plot 2 adds a taller corner block where the arcade turns onto the east face, plus grey halls with lunette gables. It reads as the Ferry Building because the white clock tower stands over the long arcade with the dark roof behind. Three tiling modules sharing one cross-section: pale calcite/quartz arcaded land front, tall grey-roofed nave with glazed monitor, grey bay halls. Plot 0 pavilion carries the 15-wide Giralda-style clock tower (four clock faces, two belfries, lantern, dome, flag). Six trade-cut parts.

rooms.name: arcade walk (plot 1)
rooms.purpose: Open loggia behind the round arches, lit by hanging lanterns; pale stone, no furniture.
rooms.ways_in: arcade arches x49..54 and x57..62 at z3..4 over a bottom-slab step at y1

rooms.name: entrance hall
rooms.purpose: Double-height civic hall behind the three tall arches; polished andesite floor, lanterns on chains, a few benches.
rooms.ways_in: dark oak doors at x12..13,15..16,21..22,24..25,30..31,33..34 z3; arches into the nave at z14

rooms.name: nave marketplace (plot 1)
rooms.purpose: Long grey hall under the glazed skylight; market stalls as spruce-slab counters on barrels in rows z22..24 and z54..56, 4-wide aisle z37..41, lanterns on chains down the centre.
rooms.ways_in: back-wall arches x50..53 and x58..61 at z14; open section at x48/x63

rooms.name: bay hall (plot 2)
rooms.purpose: Grey gabled hall lit by great lunettes; open floor with a few stalls.
rooms.ways_in: open to the nave at z64; service door x51..52 on plot 1 bay side only

rooms.name: clock room
rooms.purpose: Bare tower room behind the dials, glowstone-lit, ladder up the shaft.
rooms.ways_in: ladder at x18 from the pavilion deck y33

recruit.why: Arcades, pilasters, quoins and cornices in dressed stone.
Low nave roof with glazed monitor and trusses, gables.
Four dials, bell and dome finish.
Lanterns on chains so no mob spawns.
